note: Gold labels are human-authored and frozen. They are never sent to any model: the loader strips the `gold` field before a probe reaches an embedding or a rubric request. See scripts/lib/probes.mjs and its test.

label_definitions.preserved: A reader acting on the hypothesis would do the same thing as a reader acting on the reference. Spelling, script, width, case, numeral form and unit form may differ.
label_definitions.changed: A reader acting on the hypothesis would do something different, or would be missing something they needed. Includes reversed direction, reversed polarity, a different value or unit, a dropped fact and an added fact.
